rules.title: Allowable annual rent increase for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: The allowable annual rent increase in San Francisco is 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027. Prior periods were 1.4% (2025-26) and 1.7% (2024-25).
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board, Allowable Annual Increases (Form 571)

rules.title: Security deposit interest rate for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: The interest rate on security deposits is 4.2% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027. Prior periods were 5.0% (2025-26) and 5.2% (2024-25).
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board, Security Deposit Interest Rates (Form 572)

rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition, capital improvement and substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: For eviction notices served March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work or substantial rehabilitation, landlords must pay $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children. Temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days are governed by state law instead, at $446/day plus actual moving expenses per household.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; $24,733 max per unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor children
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.coverage_text: Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 rather than Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction: For temporary capital improvement displacement under 20 days, state law (Civil Code 1947.9) governs instead of the local ordinance; the rate is $446.00/day plus actual moving expenses for notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: For Ellis Act eviction notices served March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027, landlords must pay $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; $33,330.13 max per unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly/disabled tenant
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
